stock.description: Yun Lee Marine Group Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, delivering a broad spectrum of maritime services across Hong Kong. Its operations are divided into two main areas: vessel chartering and related support services, and comprehensive ship management. The company offers time-based charters for a variety of marine craft, including tugboats, launches, dumb lighters, and workboats, alongside specific voyage charter arrangements. Additionally, it provides ship management and a suite of ancillary services, such as vessel maintenance and repairs, supplying marine personnel, facilitating ship licensing, and offering expert maritime consultancy. The firm also participates in the construction, procurement, and sale of vessels. Its primary clientele comprises businesses within the construction and logistics sectors. Operating with a fleet of 45 owned vessels, the company supplements its capacity with ships chartered from external providers. Established in 1994, its principal office is situated in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong. Yun Lee Marine Group Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Kitling Investments (BVI) Limited.
